text: On comparative metrics of security, energy use per transaction, and governance flexibility, SPoS outperforms contemporary PoS variants such as Casper FFG and Ouroboros Praos in decentralization.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296
